title: Fire-protection rated glazing.
officialText:
Glazing in fire window assemblies shall be fire protection rated in accordance with
this section and Table 715.5. Glazing in fire door assemblies shall comply with Section 715.4.7. Fire-protection-rated
glazing shall be tested in accordance with and shall meet the acceptance criteria of NFPA 257 or UL 9. Fire-protection-
rated glazing shall also comply with NFPA 80.Openings in nonfire-resistance-rated exterior wall assemblies that require
protection in accordance with Section 705.3, 705.8, 705.8.5 or 705.8.6 shall have a fire-protection rating of not less than
¾ hour.
Exception: Wired glass in accordance with Section 715.5.4.
